answer: To resist Sybils, the network demands each agent maintain a unique behavioral pearl: a hash-chain of its prior epoch decisions salted by a private seed. Verification samples a random nadir slice of that chain and requires the agent to re-prove the intermediate steps under live timing. An attacker cloning identities must regenerate distinct full histories for every head; the compute and storage scale linearly with farm size, while an honest agent reuses its single real trajectory. The result is an opal-hard barrier: headcount buys nothing without proportional unique work.
